prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Scroll through to explore available companion journeys."]
1: ["Your pet progress and customizations automatically sync to your secure account."]
2: ["Essential Pet Care & Controls", "Learn how to summon, move, and interact with your companion on your desktop.", "Basic Desktop Controls Guide"]
3: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Your companion is officially ready to join your desktop desktop habitat!", "Adopted Companion Verified"]
4: ["Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick options or toggle visibility."]
5: ["Practice Desktop Commands", "Try moving and minimizing your desktop companion before completing onboarding.", "Test Desktop Hide & Show"]
6: ["Includes Starter Accessory Bundle"]
7: ["Signing in ensures your pet stats, accessories, and memory are permanently saved to your cloud profile."]
8: ["Your Companion is Live on Desktop!", "Use your taskbar tray icon or desktop shortcuts to interact with your new companion anytime.", "Enter Desktop Habitat"]
9: ["Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "We are assembling your pet's animations and desktop interaction engine. This takes just a moment.", "Your app will automatically display your pet on the screen when ready."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or accessory bundle
